Key architectural point: Defense-in-Depth Banking Governance
TaskForge enforces strict operational boundaries: AI agents act strictly as analytical preparers, never final approvers. The Temporal Worker executes DAG workflows within gVisor-isolated containers with zero DNS access (static endpoint injection only). Database RBAC gives agents read-only access to customer/policy data and explicitly denies access to the General Ledger (gl). When a $3M facility exceeds the AI's $100k limit, Temporal pauses the DAG at the Human Decision Gate. Financial state changes (GL journal entries, credit limit adjustments) execute only post-human approval.

Why Temporal & Defense-in-Depth Matter in this Workflow
Every analysis step executed within a fresh, isolated container with dedicated IP injection. Because AI cannot self-approve over $100k, the workflow relies on Temporal's durable pause rather than synchronous timeouts. Downstream General Ledger updates and credit limit changes cannot be executed by the agent directly; they are triggered solely by the post-approval activity following human sign-off.
